mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_goal ( child_id, financial_goal_template_id, title, target_amount, target_date, monthly_saving_amount, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{financialGoalTemplateId}, #{title}, #{targetAmount}, #{targetDate}, #{monthlySavingAmount}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
INSERT INTO financial_goal_account ( financial_goal_id, financial_account_id, linked_at ) VALUES ( #{financialGoalId}, #{financialAccountId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )

INSERT INTO financial_goal_checkpoint ( financial_goal_id, percentage, target_amount, reached_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{financialGoalId}, #{percentage}, #{targetAmount}, #{reachedAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_account SET financial_goal_template_id = #{financialGoalTemplateId}, goal_name_snapshot = #{title}, goal_target_amount = #{targetAmount}, goal_target_date = #{targetDate}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId}
